iti3:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ:
iti3:2.1: Ekadhammaṃ bhikkhave pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāya. Katamaṃ ekadhammaṃ? Mohaṃ bhikkhave ekadhammaṃ pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti3:3.1: Yena mohena mūḷhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ mohaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti3:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3||
